messages.author: c9e7fb0279d2102b
messages.subject: bismark sam output
parts:
Hi,
    The data I have is paired end. See my workflow below that starts with fastq files and involves sequence cleaning and running bismark.

After the bismark workflow, I have two bismark sam output corresponding to paired and unpaired reads. What is the best way to use these sam files for analysis in methylkit? I have concatenated the two sam files (see the workflow below). Is that the right way or will it create some problems in the analysis?


------------
My workflow starting with paired end fastq files for one sample
-------------

#Sequence cleaning using trimmomatic
java -jar trimmomatic-0.32.jar PE R1.fastq  R2.fastq 1p.fastq.gz 1u.fastq.gz 2p.fastq.gz 2u.fastq.gz \
ILLUMINACLIP:TruSeq3-PE-2.fa:2:30:10 LEADING:3 TRAILING:3 SLIDINGWINDOW:4:15 MINLEN:30

#Merge unpaired reads
  cat 1u.fastq.gz 2u.fastq.gz >unpaired.fastq.gz
 
#Run bismark on paired reads files
   bismark --bowtie2   --non_directional -N 0 -L 20 genome_bowtie2 -1 1p.fastq.gz -2 2p.fastq.gz

#Run bismark with merged unpaired reads as input
   bismark --bowtie2   --non_directional -N 0 -L 20 genome_bowtie2 unpaired.fastq.gz

#Merged sam output
  cat  1p.fastq.gz_bismark_bt2_pe.sam  <(grep -v '^@' unpaired.fastq.gz_bismark_bt2.sam ) > merged_sam.sam

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] bismark sam output
parts:
After you sort the new sam file It shouldn't be a problem, but I haven't tried pooling paired and unpaired data before. If there are problems, you can process them separately and try to pool the C and T counts externally.

Best,
Altuna

Hi,

After the bismark workflow, I have two bismark sam output corresponding to paired and unpaired reads. What is the best way to use these sam files for analysis in methylkit? ------------
My workflow starting with paired end fastq files for one sample
-------------

#Sequence cleaning using trimmomatic
java -jar trimmomatic-0.32.jar PE R1.fastq  R2.fastq 1p.fastq.gz 1u.fastq.gz 2p.fastq.gz 2u.fastq.gz \
ILLUMINACLIP:TruSeq3-PE-2.fa:2:30:10 LEADING:3 TRAILING:3 SLIDINGWINDOW:4:15 MINLEN:30

#Merge unpaired reads
  cat 1u.fastq.gz 2u.fastq.gz >unpaired.fastq.gz
 
#Run bismark on paired reads files
   bismark --bowtie2   --non_directional -N 0 -L 20 genome_bowtie2 -1 1p.fastq.gz -2 2p.fastq.gz

#Run bismark with merged unpaired reads as input
   bismark --bowtie2   --non_directional -N 0 -L 20 genome_bowtie2 unpaired.fastq.gz

#Merged sam output
  cat  1p.fastq.gz_bismark_bt2_pe.sam  <(grep -v '^@' unpaired.fastq.gz_bismark_bt2.sam ) > merged_sam.sam
